about: Hand-checked status for the seven checks on the two demo properties, in the ValuationCheck shape (id, status, detail) plus a source ID from data/sources.csv. These replace the automatic checks for these two properties only. Detail in docs/DEMO_PROPERTIES.md. V14 and V19 are private sponsor data (CoStar, Vexcel); only the observation is recorded here.

status_rules.labor: pass if the metro's construction employment is at least 100K and not down year on year (BLS CES, latest month vs same month a year earlier); watch if down; this measures the general construction workforce, not data center electricians.

costar-238029.label: 5025 Jensen Dr, Houston, TX
costar-238029.acres_note: Four HCAD lots total 1.00 ac; CoStar records 1.27 ac. Use 1.00 for land math.

utilityConnectUsd.note: Heavy power is flagged but no amperage is on record, so assume a full new service like the market default.

checks.detail: Heavy power is flagged in the property record, but no amperage is recorded and CenterPoint capacity is not confirmed.
Aqueduct baseline water stress is Medium-High (20-40%).
Houston has no citywide zoning, but the lots are platted in the City Gardens Sec 2 subdivision and its deed restrictions were not checked.
A single-family home shares the rear lot line and a YES Prep school campus is about 80 m away on Jensen Dr.
Location model scores 26/100 (Low band) for this site.
FEMA shaded Zone X (0.2% annual chance) with a drainage ditch along the south edge.
Houston metro construction employment was 269.3K in Sep 2026 (preliminary), up 5.4% from 255.5K a year earlier.

costar-755901.label: 1601 S Perrino Pl, Los Angeles, CA
costar-755901.acres_note: County Assessor lot 138,174 SF = 3.17 ac, matching CoStar.

utilityConnectUsd.note: Existing 2,600 A / 480 V 3-phase service (~2.2 MVA) covers ~1.8 MW facility load with evaporative cooling; assumes metering and protection work only. Dry cooling at PUE ~1.5 (~2.25 MW) would exceed it.

checks.detail: Existing 2,600 A / 480 V 3-phase service (~2.2 MVA) fits 1.5 MW IT with evaporative cooling but not with dry cooling; LADWP capacity not confirmed.
Aqueduct baseline water stress is Extremely High (>80%).
Zoned M3 heavy industrial, with Assessor use type Industrial; by-right data center use not confirmed with LA City Planning.
Industrial buildings and a rail line on all sides in the aerial imagery; no homes or schools adjoin.
The Texas-trained model does not score California, and no California policy review was done.
FEMA minimal flood hazard, but the parcel is tax-delinquent (default year 2026) and CoStar's condo flag conflicts with the Assessor's single fee parcel.
LA-Long Beach-Anaheim construction employment was 251.5K in Sep 2026 (preliminary), flat from 251.4K a year earlier.
